description: This source file defines API routes for handling payments via Stripe and Razorpay in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for creating checkout sessions, handling webhooks for payment confirmation, and creating orders, along with associated logic and dependencies.

methods.name: stripe_checkout(body: StripeCheckoutRequest, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session and returns a checkout URL.

methods.name: stripe_webhook(request: Request, stripe_signature: Optional[str] = Header(None))
methods.description: Handles incoming Stripe webhook events, verifies payload, and updates user status.

methods.name: razorpay_order(body: RazorpayOrderRequest, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a Razorpay order with provided details and returns order info.

methods.name: razorpay_webhook(request: Request, x_razorpay_signature: Optional[str] = Header(None))
methods.description: Handles Razorpay webhook events to confirm payment and update user status.
